name: extract-base-class
description: Extract duplicated clone_node logic into a shared mixin. Refactoring task.
task: Several node classes in src/justhtml/node.py have clone_node methods that all copy the same origin-tracking attributes: _source_html, _origin_pos, _origin_line, _origin_col. Look at which classes have this pattern and extract a CloneableNodeMixin into a new file src/justhtml/cloneable_mixin.py that captures the shared clone logic for these origin attributes.
